class.name: NNAngleVector3Sensor
class.brief_description: Accepts two vectors, calculates the angle between them and scales it to [code]0..1[/code] range.
class.description: The unsigned angle between the vectors, from [code]0[/code] to 180 degrees, is clamped to [member max_angle_radian] and divided by it. With the default maximum of 180 degrees, perpendicular vectors produce a [member NNSensors.sensor_value] of [code]0.5[/code] and opposite vectors [code]1.0[/code].

members.member: The unsigned angle between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] in degrees ([code]0[/code] to [code]180[/code]). Updated when the sensor is evaluated.

The unsigned angle between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] in radians ([code]0[/code] to [code]PI[/code]). [member NNSensors.sensor_value] is this angle clamped to [member max_angle_radian] and divided by [member max_angle_radian]. Updated when the sensor is evaluated.
Reference direction vector for the unsigned angle calculation ([code]from_vector.angle_to(to_vector)[/code]), for example the facing direction of an AI entity.

The maximum unsigned angle between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] in degrees, corresponding to [code]1.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Angles above it also score [code]1.0[/code]. Must be greater than [code]0[/code]; invalid assignments report an error and leave the value unchanged. Automatically updates [member max_angle_radian].

The maximum unsigned angle between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] in radians, corresponding to [code]1.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Angles above it also score [code]1.0[/code]. Must be greater than [code]0[/code]; invalid assignments report an error and leave the value unchanged. Automatically updates [member max_angle_degrees].
Target direction vector compared against [member from_vector] via [method Vector3.angle_to], for example the direction toward the closest enemy entity.
